TROUBLESHOOTING GUIDE - ErgoFlex Pro Office Chair (SKU: CHAIR-ERG-X99) COMMON ISSUES AND RESOLUTIONS: 1. RECLINE SQUEAKING NOISE Symptom: Audible squeaking when leaning back in the chair. Root Cause: Loose screw set S-4012-SCRW under base P-9913-BASE or worn pivot bearings. Resolution: a) Turn chair upside down on protective surface. b) Locate screw set S-4012-SCRW (4 screws) securing base P-9913-BASE to seat frame. c) Tighten all 4 screws to 12.5 Nm torque using 5mm hex key. d) If squeaking persists, inspect pivot bearings P-9912-ARM for wear. e) Replace worn bearings with part number P-9912-ARM (2 per chair). 2. HEIGHT ADJUSTMENT FAILURE Symptom: Chair sinks slowly or will not hold height position. Root Cause: Gas lift cylinder C-7721-GL internal seal failure. Resolution: a) Remove base P-9913-BASE by unscrewing 5 bolts B-3301-BLT. b) Extract gas lift cylinder C-7721-GL from column. c) Replace with new cylinder C-7721-GL. d) Reassemble in reverse order. Torque bolts B-3301-BLT to 15 Nm. 3. ARMREST WOBBLE Symptom: Excessive lateral movement in armrests. Root Cause: Loose armrest mounting brackets P-9912-ARM. Resolution: a) Remove armrest caps to access mounting bolts. b) Tighten bracket bolts B-3301-BLT to 8 Nm. c) If brackets are cracked, replace P-9912-ARM (left and right specific). 4. CASTER REPLACEMENT Symptom: Damaged or non-rolling casters. Root Cause: Debris buildup or wheel fracture. Resolution: a) Pull caster C-5500-CAST straight out from base P-9913-BASE. b) Insert new caster C-5500-CAST until audible click. c) Test all 5 casters for smooth rotation. PART NUMBERS REFERENCED: - P-9913-BASE (Chair base assembly) - P-9912-ARM (Armrest bracket, left/right) - S-4012-SCRW (M6x20 socket head cap screw, qty 4) - C-7721-GL (Gas lift cylinder, 120mm stroke) - B-3301-BLT (M8x25 flange bolt, qty 5) - C-5500-CAST (60mm nylon caster, qty 5) WARRANTY: 5-year structural, 2-year moving parts. Contact support with SKU CHAIR-ERG-X99 and serial number.

TROUBLESHOOTING GUIDE - Motorized Standing Desk Standard (SKU: DESK-STD-MOTO) COMMON ISSUES AND RESOLUTIONS: 1. DESK WON'T MOVE UP/DOWN Symptom: Control panel shows error E01 or no response. Root Cause: Motor M-8841-MOT overload or control box CB-2201-CTL fault. Resolution: a) Unplug desk for 60 seconds (hard reset). b) Check all cable connections at control box CB-2201-CTL. c) Verify motor M-8841-MOT cables not pinched. d) Run calibration: Hold DOWN button 10 seconds until display shows CAL. e) If error persists, replace control box CB-2201-CTL. 2. UNEVEN LIFTING (ONE SIDE LAGS) Symptom: Left or right leg moves slower, desk becomes unlevel. Root Cause: Spindle SP-4402-SPND binding or motor M-8841-MOT synchronization lost. Resolution: a) Inspect spindle SP-4402-SPND for debris or damage. b) Lubricate spindle with PTFE grease (part GR-9901-GRS). c) Re-run calibration procedure. d) If persistent, replace spindle SP-4402-SPND on affected side. 3. CONTROL PANEL ERROR CODES E01: Motor overload - reduce load, check for obstructions E02: Control box fault - replace CB-2201-CTL E03: Height sensor error - check sensor SN-1101-HGT wiring E04: Anti-collision triggered - clear obstruction, reset E05: Motor sync lost - run full calibration 4. MEMORY PRESET NOT WORKING Symptom: Saved positions not recalling correctly. Root Cause: Control box CB-2201-CTL memory corruption. Resolution: a) Clear all presets: Hold M button 5 seconds. b) Re-program positions using UP/DOWN then M + number. c) If fails, replace control box CB-2201-CTL. PART NUMBERS REFERENCED: - M-8841-MOT (Dual motor kit, 24V DC) - CB-2201-CTL (Control box with Bluetooth) - SP-4402-SPND (Lifting spindle, 600mm) - SN-1101-HGT (Hall effect height sensor) - B-3301-BLT (M8x30 mounting bolt, qty 8) - GR-9901-GRS (PTFE spindle grease, 50g tube) SPECIFICATIONS: - Height range: 620mm - 1270mm - Load capacity: 100kg - Speed: 32mm/s - Duty cycle: 2 min on / 18 min off WARRANTY: 7-year frame, 3-year electronics. SKU DESK-STD-MOTO.

INSTALLATION & TROUBLESHOOTING - Dual Monitor Arm Heavy Duty (SKU: MON-ARM-DUAL) INSTALLATION STEPS: 1. Choose mounting method: C-clamp (desk thickness 10-85mm) or Grommet (hole 8-10mm). 2. For C-clamp: Attach base plate BP-6601-BP using clamp CM-7701-CMP. 3. For Grommet: Insert bolt GM-8801-GMT through desk, secure with nut. 3. Mount vertical pole VP-5501-VP to base plate BP-6601-BP. 4. Attach monitor brackets MB-4401-MB to VESA 75x75 or 100x100 patterns. 5. Slide brackets onto pole VP-5501-VP, set height, tighten knobs KN-2201-KNB. 6. Route cables through cable management clips CM-3301-CMC. TROUBLESHOOTING: 1. MONITOR SAGS OVER TIME Symptom: Monitor slowly tilts down after adjustment. Root Cause: Gas spring GS-9901-GSP losing pressure or knob KN-2201-KNB loose. Resolution: a) Tighten tension adjustment knob KN-2201-KNB clockwise. b) If monitor > 8kg, verify gas spring GS-9901-GSP rating (supports 2-9kg per arm). c) Replace gas spring GS-9901-GSP if internal pressure lost. 2. ARM WON'T STAY IN POSITION Symptom: Joints drift, monitor moves unintentionally. Root Cause: Pivot bolts PT-1101-PVT loose or worn. Resolution: a) Tighten all pivot bolts PT-1101-PVT to 5 Nm. b) Apply thread locker (blue) to PT-1101-PVT threads. c) If bolts stripped, replace pivot assembly PT-1101-PVT. 3. VESA BRACKET MISALIGNMENT Symptom: Monitor sits crooked or bracket doesn't align. Root Cause: VESA adapter AD-2202-ADP incorrect orientation. Resolution: a) Remove bracket MB-4401-MB. b) Rotate VESA adapter AD-2202-ADP 90 degrees. c) Reattach and verify level. PART NUMBERS REFERENCED: - BP-6601-BP (Base plate, steel) - CM-7701-CMP (C-clamp assembly) - GM-8801-GMT (Grommet mount bolt) - VP-5501-VP (Vertical pole, 400mm) - MB-4401-MB (Monitor bracket, VESA 75/100) - KN-2201-KNB (Tension adjustment knob) - GS-9901-GSP (Gas spring, 2-9kg range) - PT-1101-PVT (Pivot bolt, M6) - AD-2202-ADP (VESA adapter plate) - CM-3301-CMC (Cable management clip, qty 4) LOAD RATING: 9kg per arm (18kg total). VESA 75x75 / 100x100. WARRANTY: 3-year mechanical. SKU MON-ARM-DUAL.

TROUBLESHOOTING GUIDE - ErgoSplit Mechanical Keyboard (SKU: KB-ERGO-SPLIT) COMMON ISSUES AND RESOLUTIONS: 1. KEY CHATTER / DOUBLE INPUT Symptom: Single keypress registers multiple times. Root Cause: Switch debounce failure or dirty switch contacts. Resolution: a) Remove keycap using puller KP-1101-PUL. b) Use compressed air to clean switch SW-2201-SWT. c) If persistent, desolder and replace switch SW-2201-SWT (Cherry MX compatible). d) Update firmware to v2.3+ for improved debounce algorithm. 2. LEFT/RIGHT HALF NOT CONNECTING Symptom: One half unpaired, LED flashing red. Root Cause: TRRS cable CB-3301-CBL damaged or wireless module WM-4401-WLS fault. Resolution: a) Inspect TRRS cable CB-3301-CBL for bent pins or cuts. b) Test with known good cable CB-3301-CBL. c) For wireless: Re-pair by holding PAIR button 3s on both halves. d) Replace wireless module WM-4401-WLS if pairing fails. 3. RGB LIGHTING ISSUES Symptom: LEDs stuck, wrong colors, or not responding. Root Cause: LED driver LD-5501-LDR fault or firmware bug. Resolution: a) Reset to default: Hold FN + ESC 5 seconds. b) Update firmware via USB to latest version. c) If hardware fault, replace PCB PC-6601-PCB (left or right specific). 4. KEYCAP STEM BREAKAGE Symptom: Keycap loose or falls off. Root Cause: Stem fracture on keycap KP-1101-KCP. Resolution: a) Replace keycap KP-1101-KCP (standard MX stem). b) Available in sets: KP-1101-KCP-SET (base), KP-1101-KCP-MOD (modifiers). TROUBLESHOOTING GUIDE - Vertical Ergonomic Mouse Pro (SKU: MOUSE-VERT-PRO) COMMON ISSUES AND RESOLUTIONS: 1. CURSOR JITTER / ERRATIC MOVEMENT Symptom: Cursor jumps, stutters, or moves randomly. Root Cause: Sensor lens dirty, surface incompatibility, or sensor SN-8801-SNS fault. Resolution: a) Clean sensor lens with microfiber cloth (no liquids). b) Use on non-reflective mouse pad MP-9901-MPD. c) Adjust DPI via button or software (400-26000 DPI). d) If persistent, sensor SN-8801-SNS (PixArt PAW3395) may need replacement. 2. WIRELESS DISCONNECTIONS Symptom: Mouse disconnects frequently, LED blinks amber. Root Cause: 2.4GHz dongle DG-1101-DGL interference or battery BT-2201-BAT low. Resolution: a) Move dongle DG-1101-DGL to front USB port (use extension if needed). b) Replace battery BT-2201-BAT (AA, 1.5V alkaline or NiMH). c) Re-pair: Hold DPI + RIGHT click 3s, plug dongle. d) Update firmware via manufacturer software. 3. BUTTON DOUBLE-CLICK ISSUE Symptom: Single click registers as double-click. Root Cause: Switch SW-3301-SWT (Omron 50M) contact bounce. Resolution: a) Update firmware for improved debounce (v1.2+). b) If hardware fault, replace switch SW-3301-SWT (requires soldering). c) Contact support for RMA if under warranty. 4. CHARGING NOT WORKING (WIRELESS MODEL) Symptom: No charging indicator, battery drains fast. Root Cause: USB-C port PT-4401-PRT damaged or charging IC CH-5501-CHG fault. Resolution: a) Test with known good USB-C cable CB-6601-CBL. b) Clean port PT-4401-PRT with compressed air. c) If no charge, replace charging board CH-5501-CHG. PART NUMBERS REFERENCED: - SN-8801-SNS (PixArt PAW3395 optical sensor) - SW-3301-SWT (Omron 50M switch, left/right/main) - DG-1101-DGL (2.4GHz USB dongle) - BT-2201-BAT (AA battery compartment) - PT-4401-PRT (USB-C charging port) - CH-5501-CHG (Charging controller IC) - CB-6601-CBL (USB-C to USB-A cable, 1.8m) - MP-9901-MPD (Mouse pad, cloth, 300x250mm) - SK-7701-SKT (PTFE mouse feet, set of 4) SPECIFICATIONS: - Sensor: PixArt PAW3395 - DPI: 400-26000 (50 DPI steps) - Polling: 1000Hz (wired/2.4GHz), 125Hz (Bluetooth) - Battery: 70 hours (2.4GHz), 120 hours (Bluetooth) - Weight: 78g (without battery) WARRANTY: 2-year. TROUBLESHOOTING GUIDE - Wireless Pro Headset (SKU: HEADSET-WL-PRO) COMMON ISSUES AND RESOLUTIONS: 1. NO AUDIO / ONE SIDE ONLY Symptom: No sound or only left/right channel working. Root Cause: Audio cable AC-1101-CBL loose, driver DR-2201-DRV failure, or wireless interference. Resolution: a) For wired mode: Check 3.5mm cable AC-1101-CBL connection. b) For wireless: Re-pair dongle DG-2201-DGL (hold power 5s). c) Test on another device to isolate. d) If one driver dead, replace driver unit DR-2201-DRV (40mm dynamic). 2. MICROPHONE NOT WORKING Symptom: Mic muted, low volume, or static. Root Cause: Mic boom MB-3301-BM not seated, mic capsule MC-4401-MIC fault, or software settings. Resolution: a) Ensure mic boom MB-3301-BM fully inserted (click feel). b) Check mute switch on left earcup (LED red = muted). c) In OS sound settings, select HEADSET-WL-PRO mic, set level 80%. d) If static persists, replace mic capsule MC-4401-MIC (unidirectional). 3. WIRELESS RANGE / DROPOUTS Symptom: Audio cuts out beyond 3m or near WiFi router. Root Cause: 2.4GHz congestion or dongle DG-2201-DGL placement. Resolution: a) Use USB extension to move dongle DG-2201-DGL away from PC case. b) Switch WiFi to 5GHz band. c) Update headset firmware (addresses coexistence). d) Try Bluetooth mode (lower latency tolerance). 4. EARPAD DETERIORATION Symptom: Peeling, cracking, or comfort loss. Root Cause: Protein leather wear. Resolution: a) Replace earpads EP-5501-EPD (protein leather) or EP-5501-EPD-VEL (velour). b) Pull old pads off, align new pads, press firmly. 5. BATTERY LIFE DEGRADATION Symptom: Runtime significantly reduced from rated 40h. Root Cause: Battery BT-6601-BAT aging. Resolution: a) Full discharge/charge cycle 3x to recalibrate gauge. b) If < 50% rated life, replace battery BT-6601-BAT (service center only). PART NUMBERS REFERENCED: - DR-2201-DRV (40mm dynamic driver, 32 ohm) - MC-4401-MIC (Unidirectional mic capsule) - DG-2201-DGL (2.4GHz USB-C dongle) - MB-3301-BM (Detachable mic boom) - EP-5501-EPD (Earpads, protein leather, pair) - EP-5501-EPD-VEL (Earpads, velour, pair) - BT-6601-BAT (Li-ion battery, 1200mAh) - AC-1101-CBL (3.5mm audio cable, 1.5m) - CB-7701-CBL (USB-C charging cable, 1.2m) - HD-8801-HDB (Headband padding replacement) SPECIFICATIONS: - Driver: 40mm dynamic, 20Hz-20kHz - Mic: Unidirectional, -38dB sensitivity - Wireless: 2.4GHz (dongle) + Bluetooth 5.3 - Battery: 40h (2.4GHz), 50h (Bluetooth) - Weight: 298g WARRANTY: 2-year.
